text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! I finally got it! The "Carrotman 
Encyclopedia"!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm reading through this whole 
thing in one go today!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm…… Such a setting…… 
……*snooze*……*snooze*…………"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Where on earth is this...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus?
text_block_list.text:
You've arrived, Justice Biko! I've been 
waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-Who the heck are you?! Why is there 
another me... Facebook?!

text_block_list.name: Biko No. 2
text_block_list.text: I am Justice Biko No. 2!! Your other self!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat!? I had a secondary hero 
alongside me this whole time?!

text_block_list.name: Biko No. 2
text_block_list.text:
"Justice Biko! Your running still has a 
long way to go! You'll never uphold 
justice like that!"

text_block_list.name: Biko No. 2
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you how a hero runs! Let's 
settle this over 1600m on turf! Uwoooooh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't really understand, but... after 
being told all that, there's no way I can 
just keep quiet!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, Biko No. 2! I'm gonna prove to 
you that No. 1 is the coolest of them all!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Damn it, she's fast! With footwork I've 
never seen before, she's steadily pulling 
ahead...!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gonna lose at this rate! What do I 
do... what can I do—?!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, that's it! If that guy can do me, 
then I just gotta imitate him too—!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAY! I won! I wooooooon!

text_block_list.name: Biko No. 2
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Not bad, No. 1! Don't forget that 
footwork you just used!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Number 2... Could it be! Did you do this 
just so I could get faster—

text_block_list.name: Biko No. 2
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Farewell, Justice Biko! I'll 
always be right here in your heart!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Gah?! ...Ah, it was a dream... Oh, okay.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Justice Biko No. 2, huh. Someday, 
I hope we can fight evil together...

And so, Biko Pegasus closed the open 
volume of Carrotman 2.

From this day on, Biko Pegasus's running 
became more refined and gained even more 
sharpness.
